args.title: Remember the export format choice in ExportButton component
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change ExportButton to remember the last chosen export format using browser storage (e.g., localStorage) so the format menu is pre-selected with the user's last used format, preventing accidental exports in the default format.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This file is responsible for the export format selection UI next to the Export button. To implement the requested feature, the ExportButton component should be changed to remember the last chosen format in the browser's storage (such as localStorage) and initialize the format selector with it on each load.
